lines: The wheel of diverse states, widely flashing,
comes to be the objects of experience:
is thus the bond of nondifference —
treasury of the lights of knowing.
sanskrit_cite: ya eṣa vitatasphuradvividhabhāvacakrātmakaḥ parasparavibhedavānviṣayatāmupāgacchati yadekamayabhāvanāvaśata etyabhedānvayaṃ sa śaṃbhuraśivāpaho jayati bodhabhāsāṃ nidhiḥ
notes: prathiḥ + bhāvanāvaśata + ety + śivāpaha: LIVE forks held (grounds in L0)

lines: By the sage Dvaipāyana this scripture
was expounded — measured by hundreds of thousands;
here liberation stands as the fruit —
sanskrit_cite: dvaipāyanena muninā yadidaṃ vyadhāyi sāstraṃ sahasraśatasaṃmitamatra mokṣaḥ mādhānyataḥ phalatayā prathitastadanya- dharmādi tasya paripoṣayituṃ pragītam
notes: mādhānyataḥ LIVE fork: neutral surface held (grounds in L0 + argmap option_choices); no gloss in song

sanskrit_cite: mokṣaśca nāma sakalāpravibhāgarūpe sarvajñasarvakaraṇādiśubhasvabhāve ākāṅkṣya virahite bhagavatyadhīśe nityodite laya iyānprathiḥ samāsāt
notes: prathiḥ + bhāvanāvaśata + ety + śivāpaha: LIVE forks held (grounds in L0)

lines: Other connections celebrate liberation by name;
yet this Bhagavadgītā gives true attainment.
sanskrit_cite: yadyapyanyaprasaṅgeṣu mokṣo nāmātra gīyate tathāpi bhagavadgītāḥ samyaktatprāptidāyikāḥ

lines: Earlier ones made many expositions among them —
yet this attempt too is reasonable,
sanskrit_cite: tāsvanyaiḥ prāktanairvyākhyāḥ kṛtā yadyapi bhūyasā nyāyyastathāpyudyamo me tadgūḍhārthaprakāśakaḥ

lines: examined long with thought, made by Abhinavagupta:
sanskrit_cite: bhaṭṭendurājādāmnāya vivicya ca ciraṃ dhiyā kṛto'bhinavaguptena so'yaṃ gītārthasaṃgrahaḥ
